title: Skills registry (.agents/skills/registry.json)
description: AGT-05 (M3.3): declares, per canonical skill under .agents/skills/<id>/, which profiles/roles/SDD levels it applies to. runtime/adapters/skills.mjs uses this to materialize only the applicable subset per tool instead of TEMPLATE v2.0.5's unconditional mirror-everything (sync-agentic-adapters.ps1 Sync-Skills).

profiles.description: profiles/*.json ids this skill applies to, or ["*"] for every profile.
